tasks.label: Configure: Windows (sccache)
tasks.detail: Configure the project for Windows using Ninja and sccache.

tasks.label: Configure: Android
tasks.command: cmake -B build/android -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${env:ANDROID_NDK_HOME}/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-33 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DGODOTCPP_DISABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON . ; if ($?) { (Get-Content build/android/compile_commands.json) | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace('C:\\', 'c:\\').Replace('C:/', 'c:/') } | Set-Content build/android/compile_commands.json -Encoding UTF8 }
tasks.detail: Configure the project for Android and patch compile_commands.json casing.

tasks.label: Configure: Android (sccache)
tasks.command: cmake -B build/android -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=sccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=sccache -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${env:ANDROID_NDK_HOME}/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-33 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DGODOTCPP_DISABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON . ; if ($?) { (Get-Content build/android/compile_commands.json) | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace('C:\\', 'c:\\').Replace('C:/', 'c:/') } | Set-Content build/android/compile_commands.json -Encoding UTF8 }
tasks.detail: Configure the project for Android using sccache and patch compile_commands.json casing.

tasks.command: cmake --build build/android --target check | tee -FilePath temp/clang-tidy-check.txt -Encoding utf8
